description: LANDSCAPE 640x360 PIXEL ART GAME BACKGROUND ONLY. The inviting entrance vestibule of a medieval fantasy training guild, in the SAME visual world as the reference. Believable door hinges, thresholds and wall thickness. Door opening mostly between x=55 and x=270, no warped duplicate doors. Ceiling timber supports along top edge. Floor occupies bottom fifth, level threshold and consistent floor joints with plausible perspective, not a random tile grid. Soft warm light spills out through the left door; right wall remains calm and dark for readable interface contrast. Welcoming, grounded RPG atmosphere, no dramatic bloom or fog. Entire source canvas opaque. Architecture, doors, floor and distant view only. NO characters, UI, text, numerals, logos, signs, buttons, plaques, form, decorative frame, loose props, statues, weapons, boxing ring, furniture, treasure, food, potions, sparkles or visual effects. Do not copy the exact reference room layout: use it for coherent pixel density, materials and palette. Keep the focal doorway fully visible behind the left side of the eventual screen; calm right side and open bottom edge.
